facts.text: Jejich hlavními predátory jsou vlci, kojoti, medvědi černí a medvědi grizzly.
facts.quote: Primary predators of this sheep are wolf packs, coyotes, black bears, and grizzly bears
golden eagles are predators of the young

facts.text: Dokáže shodit vlka z útesu ranou rohy.
facts.quote: O. dalli have been known to butt gray wolves off the face of cliffs.

facts.text: V zimě se živí zmrzlými travami, ostřicemi, lišejníky nebo mechy.
facts.quote: In the winter, food is limited to what is available in snow-free areas, such as frozen grasses, sedges, lichens, or mosses.

facts.text: Na jaře putuje na velké vzdálenosti k solným lizům, aby doplnil potravu o minerály.
facts.quote: will travel long distances in the spring to visit mineral licks to supplement their diet

facts.text: Tento druh se dožívá 12 až 16 let.
facts.quote: O. dalli can live to be 12 to 16 years of age.
